Keywords filter on-device (only matching lines are returned); the top search box filters/highlights locally. Both can be combined.

Pairing reset: on the home screen tap the status row → Connect page to pair again
Address cleared; the next connection will re-scan

Update package ready — tap "Check updates" to install
A log capture tool with built-in ADB wireless debugging: no root, no PC, no cable — capture your phone\'s logs right on the phone.
Log capture · Live tailing · One-tap export · Crash monitoring
Tech: embedded ADB protocol (Kadb TLS wireless pairing); supports ADB direct and HostBridge channels.
Note: captured logs may contain sensitive information — review before sharing.
%1$d%% · come back here to install when done
Tap "Install" to launch the system installer. If installation is blocked, allow LogLab to "install unknown apps" in system settings first.
Port not responding; scanning for wireless debugging…
Connected; checking whether the port is up to date…
Waiting for the wireless debugging service to appear…
Wireless debugging port changed (%1$d → %2$d); updated and reconnected automatically
Wireless debugging pairing not completed: open "Settings → Developer options → Wireless debugging → Pair device with pairing code", then pair in the app settings page
Wireless debugging is off — tap to enable
Paired but cannot connect; make sure "Wireless debugging" is on
No debugging port found; make sure wireless debugging is on!
No debugging port found; make sure wireless debugging is on! (mDNS found %1$d services but address resolution failed — system mDNS is restricted; enter IP:port manually on the connect page)
No debugging port found; make sure wireless debugging is on! (mDNS scan failed to start: %1$s; enter IP:port manually on the connect page)
No debugging port found; make sure wireless debugging is on! (mDNS scan returned nothing — if the switch is on, the system may restrict mDNS; enter IP:port manually on the connect page)
Found %1$d wireless debugging services but cannot connect; direct probe: %2$s
Found %1$d wireless debugging services but cannot connect
Tip: pair in split-screen/floating window — no app switching in between, so the pairing code is not refreshed
First float this app: long-press it in Recents → "Freeform" (or drag it out of the sidebar)
On the main screen open "Developer options → Wireless debugging → Pair device with pairing code"
Type the code shown on the main screen below → Start pairing (keep the system dialog open)
The port is usually detected automatically; if not, type the port shown in the pairing dialog (e.g. 43185).
Type the IP:port shown on the "Wireless debugging" screen (different from the pairing port; it changes every time you toggle it).
No devices found. Some ROMs (e.g. ColorOS) disable scanning — expand "Manual address" and type the IP:port shown on the Wireless debugging screen
Found %1$d services — tap the "Wireless debugging" one to connect; pairing port auto-filled
%1$s:%2$d is a pairing port, for one-time pairing only and cannot capture logs; pick the "Wireless debugging" one instead
Connected to %1$s:%2$d (loopback failed; fell back to the LAN address)
make sure wireless debugging is on
ADB: unavailable — make sure wireless debugging is on
Detecting the pairing port… (make sure the system "Pair device with pairing code" dialog is open)
Could not detect the pairing port automatically (some systems restrict mDNS): type the port from the pairing dialog "IP address and port" into "Port (optional)" and tap "Start pairing" again
Key written; restart adbd and reconnect
Open "Settings → Developer options → Wireless debugging" and keep it on
Tap the status bar on top to open the connect page; pair in split-screen: long-press this app in Recents → "Freeform" to float it, then open "Pair device with pairing code" on the main screen
Type the code shown on the main screen into the floating window → Start pairing (port auto-detected; pairing happens only once)
Note: leaving the app or closing the dialog during pairing refreshes both the code and the port — split-screen avoids this.
① Type the pairing code in the floating window (right); keep the pairing dialog open on the main screen
② Connected automatically after pairing; daily capture does not need pairing again
Open this app — it connects automatically and tracks port changes; no manual edits needed
After capture: ⋮ copy all / 💾 save to file
"Wireless debugging" is just a switch: turn it off when idle and back on when needed.
Switch to the "Crashes" tab and tap "Start monitoring"
Open the app that crashes and let it crash once
Back on "Crashes", records and stack traces appear automatically — copy or share them
Make sure the "Wireless debugging" switch is on (the most common cause)
Tap the status bar on the home screen → Connect device → "Rescan"
Still failing: expand "Manual address" and type the IP:port from the Wireless debugging screen
The first connection requires pairing once; after that, port changes do not need re-pairing.
Note: captured logs may contain sensitive info (accounts, locations, etc.). Review before sharing.
No app list; make sure the device is connected and tap "Refresh" to retry
